questions.q: In animal husbandry, any edible substance that is safely consumed, digested, and utilized by farm animals to provide nutrients is called ________.
questions.explain: Feed (or animal feed) refers to the food given to domestic farm animals to supply the required nutrients for their growth, maintenance, and production.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which class of animal feed is predominantly formulated to provide the animal with the power and heat necessary for physical movement and work?
questions.explain: Energy-yielding feeds (like maize, sorghum, and root crops) are rich in carbohydrates and fats. They provide the bulk of the animal's dietary energy required for daily activities.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following feed ingredients is a typical example of a protein-yielding feed used in animal nutrition?
questions.explain: Fish meal, soya bean meal, and blood meal are high-protein concentrates. They are primarily added to feeds to provide proteins for body building and tissue repair.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: What is the primary function of feeding troughs in animal husbandry?
options: To hold water for the animals to drink
To collect the waste generated by the animals
To hold solid and semi-solid feeds for the animals to eat
To store harvested grains for long periods
questions.explain: Feeding troughs are long, shallow containers built from wood, metal, or concrete specifically used to present feed to farm animals hygienically.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Equipment specifically designed to provide clean and accessible drinking water to farm animals on the farm are called ________.
questions.explain: Drinker sets (or waterers) are feeding tools designed specifically to hold and dispense drinking water to livestock and poultry.
